odc_type: Incorrect Type Resolution in Error Reporting
observation_summary: The compiler reports an incorrect type name in the error message when a property is missing on an object.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the type checker incorrectly identifies the type of an object property during error reporting. When a property access fails on a member variable (e.g., 'this.c2_.prop'), the compiler reports the error as 'Property prop never defined on C3.c2_' instead of 'Property prop never defined on C2'. This indicates that the type inference or the error message generation logic is failing to resolve the underlying type of the property access expression, instead using the literal path of the expression in the error message.
